title: Northern Kalapuya language
description: Extinct Native American language formerly spoken in Oregon
extract: Northern Kalapuyan is an extinct Kalapuyan language indigenous to northwestern Oregon in the United States. It was spoken by Kalapuya groups in the northern Willamette Valley southwest of present-day Portland.
